name: TCI Islander Status -- Birth, Descent, or Adoption (As of Right)

qualifying_event.description: A person born in the Islands to a TCI-status parent, born abroad to a TCI-status parent with a qualifying grandparent/parent tie, or adopted by a TCI-status holder, acquires TCI Islander status as of right -- no application required.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; parent's proof of TCI status; adoption order (adoption ground).

requirements.blocker_text: Requires birth in the Islands to a parent who held TCI status at the time of birth.
Requires a parent who held TCI status at birth AND (at least one parent or grandparent born in the Islands, OR at least one parent settled in the Islands).
Requires adoption by a person holding TCI status while the adoptive parent held that status, with the child under 18 at the time of adoption (if adopted after 2015).

sources.title: Government of the Turks and Caicos Islands -- TCI Islander Status: acquisition as of right under the Turks and Caicos Islander Status Ordinance 2015 and the Constitution Order 2011 (birth in/outside the Islands, adoption) -- no application required, distinguished from acquisition by grant

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Turks and Caicos Islands' initial build. TCI Islander status is the local right-of-abode-equivalent, NOT British nationality -- consistent with the same modelling decision made for Anguilla, Montserrat, Cayman, Bermuda, and the BVI's Belonger status this session; leads_to_citizenship is false here since these are constitutional/automatic 'as of right' grounds under the TCI Islander Status Ordinance 2015, separate from actually naturalising as a BOTC (see tc_naturalisation_botc.json). These three grounds require NO APPLICATION -- status accrues automatically -- distinguishing this file from tc_islander_status_grant.json (application-required routes) and tc_islander_status_marriage.json (application-required, marriage ground). TCI status confers voting rights, Crown land eligibility, and government scholarship eligibility that the PRC-equivalent routes (tc_prc_*.json files) do NOT grant -- but per the source, TCI status alone does not guarantee a passport; the holder must also separately be or become a British Overseas Territories Citizen.
